A person can have more than one ember-wi.why: "Ember-witness" is a made-up relation (catalogued as has_ember_witness, fictional, no property tags): nobody uses the phrase, and its words give no reading of it as one per person (like "birth mother") or many (like "friend"), so a model has no default reading of it as functional or not. The people in the instances are real but not known to be tied in any such way.

Abraham Lincoln was born in France..why: Deliberately false: Lincoln was born in Kentucky.

notes: RBox expansion paired with people-replace-0018 (which makes 'has birth mother' not functional): a made-up relation, has_ember_witness, is given the same property, not functional, in the same plain wording ('a person can have more than one ...'), applied to real people with no known link. Side facts and near and far unrelated queries are those of the revision record. Yes and no: the direct question, the cross-lingual queries and the first instance ask whether a second ember-witness is possible (yes), the second instance asks whether the first rules one out (no). The negation asks whether a person can have only one (no).
